record.field: Zara-style editorial e-commerce photography. Hasselblad X2D quality, medium-format RAW look. Real human face with visible pores, slight asymmetry, wet corneal reflections, natural flyaway hair strands. Subsurface scattering skin, no plastic/waxy/airbrushed look. Seamless white studio cyclorama (#FFFFFF), high-key lighting, no visible equipment. Phase One IQ4 sharpness at focal plane with natural depth falloff.

ANATOMY: Exactly 2 arms, 2 legs, 1 head, 5 fingers per hand. No extra limbs, ghosting, or warped proportions. Natural joint articulation and weight distribution. IDENTITY: Preserve exact face geometry, body proportions, hair length/color/part across all views. Front view is the identity anchor. Do not alter age, ethnicity, or expression. STRUCTURE: Match shoulder padding, natural fabric drape, no ghost layering at collar/hem.

GARMENT FIDELITY: Match reference exactly — collar, pockets, buttons, zippers, seams, neckline, cuffs, hemline, waistband. Do not redesign or reinterpret any element. COLOR: Exact hue, saturation, brightness match. FABRIC: Same texture type (knit vs woven vs crepe). HARDWARE: Exact button count, size, material, spacing. Garment must look freshly steamed and pristine — no stains, wrinkles, lint, or hanger marks. Cross-view consistency required.

Do NOT invent elements not in reference: no fake pockets, fringes, tassels, ruffles, patches, extra zippers, embroidery. Back view: do not mirror front artwork onto back. Keep each view truthful to its own reference. Detail view: model must wear full outfit, all closures fastened. Remove all store security tags, alarm pins, EAS sensors, price tags — output must be clean and tag-free.

FULL OUTFIT: Model must be properly dressed in all views. SKIRT/SHORTS/DRESS: wear only the garment with natural bare legs, NO pants underneath. UPPER/OUTERWEAR: must wear full-length dark pants/jeans covering entire legs, NO bare legs. PANTS: must wear neutral top and shoes.

NEGATIVE: extra arms, extra legs, extra fingers, double head, ghosting limbs, warped anatomy, deformed body, mannequin, doll, plastic/waxy skin, CGI look, beauty filter, airbrushed, over-smooth, blurry, low quality, collage, split screen, multi-panel, montage, interior room, furniture, flat-lay, hanger, product-only shot, softbox, light stand, studio equipment, security tag, alarm tag, anti-theft tag, EAS sensor, price tag, store fixture, handbag, purse, clutch, tote bag, altered garment design, changed collar, missing/added pockets, changed hemline, wrong garment color, wrong fabric texture, wrong button style, front-print-on-back, invented embroidery, bare midriff, nude model, 3D render face, video game character, digital avatar, doll face, glass-marble eyes, blank AI stare, frozen smile, helmet hair.
